destination.name: Clerk of the Iowa District Court for the county of the case
destination.detail: File in the case where expungement is sought. The county attorney is served and has 20 days to respond.

evidence.filingRule: eFile through the Iowa Judicial Branch eFile System where the case is available there, otherwise file on paper at the county clerk of court office. The application is filed in the case where expungement is sought, so separate cases require separate applications.
evidence.serviceRule: eFiling serves the county attorney automatically. Paper filers complete the certification of service and mail or hand deliver a copy to the county attorney of the county where the application is filed.

SELF_HELP_STOP.basis: IA legal-track stop conditions, participant instructions and conservative route controls.
SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The instructions stop self-help for multiple convictions/related cases, pending charges, prior relief, uncertain deferred judgments, opposition, immigration consequences, comparability categories and the retained 235B.20 discrepancy. They preserve the one-per-lifetime, eight-year and no-felony-relief boundaries.

stopConditions: The participant has more than one potentially eligible conviction, because the choice is strategic and permanent.
The offence may fall under § 901C.3(2)(w) or (x), the comparability categories.
The participant is unsure whether a prior disposition was a deferred judgment.
The county attorney responds in opposition.
